استوقين (form X)
# اِسْتَوْقَيْنَ (istawqayna) /is.taw.qaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَوْقَى (istawqā)
# اُسْتُوقِينَ (ustūqīna) /us.tuː.qiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَوْقَى (istawqā)
# اِسْتَوْقِينَ (istawqīna) /is.taw.qiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَوْقَى (istawqā)
